field_text_formatted.value: The image widget no longer shows the wrong thumbnail when two uploads share a name (#3277844). A new upload no longer creates a redirect every time (#3494240), and the PHP 8.2 that rc2 already needed is finally declared (#3622262). Being stable also means security advisory coverage.
